sources.title: Bṛhat Parāśara Horā Śāstra chapter 34 verse 4
sources.verse_devanagari: सप्तमं दशमं चैव विशेषसुखमुच्यते । त्रिषडायाधिपाः सर्वे ग्रहाः पापफलाः स्मृताः ॥४॥
sources.applies_to: Identify seventh and tenth house roles in a traditional review; no standalone marriage/job prediction

sources.title: Bṛhat Parāśara Horā Śāstra chapter 48 verse 8
sources.applies_to: Qualified Daśā review compares planetary condition at period commencement and birth; output withheld if only period lord available

sources.title: Bṛhat Parāśara Horā Śāstra chapter 48 verse 9
sources.verse_devanagari: पञ्चमेशेन युक्तस्य कर्मेशस्य दशा शुभा । नवमेशेन युक्तस्य कर्मेशस्यातिशभना ॥९॥
sources.applies_to: Candidate sign-conjunction evidence for tenth lord with fifth or ninth lord, contextualized in tenth-lord Daśā; not a guaranteed benefit

sources.title: Varāhamihira Bṛhat Jātaka chapter 10 verse 1 (Vocation)
sources.applies_to: Display the tenth sign and occupants counted separately from Lagna, Moon and Sun; Navāṁśa lord/context also needed before vocation claims

sources.title: Praśna Mārga chapter 20 verse 3
sources.applies_to: Marriage indications require seventh house, seventh lord, grahas/aspects and Venus, with conditioning checks; no solo exact wedding date
